        "contents": "/**\n * 字段映射规则\n */\nexport interface FieldMappingRule {\n  workflowInputName: string; // 工作流输入参数名\n  sourceType: 'field' | 'expression'; // 映射来源类型\n  sourceField?: string; // AI对话字段名（如 'query', 'sources', 'files'）\n  expression?: string; // 表达式映射（支持JavaScript表达式）\n  defaultValue?: any; // 默认值（当源字段为空时）\n}\n\n/**\n * 输出字段映射规则\n */\nexport interface OutputMappingRule {\n  workflowOutputName: string\n}",

已修改 `FieldMappingManagementPage.tsx`，使“新增AI模块”支持连续追加多个自定义模块。主要变更：

1. **新增状态管理**：

        "contents": "const AIRoleManagementPage: React.FC = \n // Debug state\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 先加载localStorage中的配置（用于显示）\n    const configs = migrationService.getLocalStorageConfigs();\n    setLocalStorageConfigs(configs);\n    \n    // 然后加载角色和检查迁移状态（合并调用以减少重复请求）\n    const initData = async () =&gt; {\n      let loadedRoles: AIRoleConfig[] = [];\n      try {\n        // 先尝试加载角色\n        loadedRoles = await aiRoleService.getAIRoles();\n        // 去重：基于ID去除重复的角色\n        const uniqueRoles = Array.from(\n          new Map(loadedRoles.map(role =&gt; [role.id, role])).values()\n        );\n        setRoles(uniqueRoles);\n      } catch (error) {\n        // 如果加载失败（后端未运行），继续检查迁移状态\n      }\n      // 检查迁移状态（传入已加载的角色，避免重复调用API）\n      await checkMigrationStatus(loadedRoles);\n      try {\n        // 默认显示全部自编工作流\n        const wfs = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n        setPublishedWorkflows(wfs);\n      } catch {}\n    };\n    \n        initData();\n        // 加载后检查重复角色\n        checkDuplicates();\n      }, []);\n\n  // 检查重复角色\n  const checkDuplicates = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const duplicates = await aiRoleService.findDuplicates();\n      if (duplicates &amp;&amp; duplicates.totalDuplicates &gt; 0) {\n        setDuplicateInfo(duplicates);\n      } else {\n        // 没有重复或获取失败时，清除状态\n        setDuplicateInfo(null);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 静默处理错误，不影响页面正常显示\n      setDuplicateInfo(null);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublishedWorkflows = async ()\n;\n;",

        "contents": "-- AI角色相关数据库表\n\n-- 1. AI角色表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_roles (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT NOT NULL,\n    avatar TEXT,                     -- 角色头像URL（可选）\n    system_prompt TEXT,               -- 系统提示词（可选）\n    dify_config TEXT NOT NULL,       -- JSON字符串，存储Dify配置（apiUrl, apiKey, connectionType, inputFields）\n    enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- 0或1，是否启用\n    source TEXT,                     -- 来源标记：'smart-workflow', 'independent-page', 'custom'\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_name ON ai_roles(name);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_enabled ON ai_roles(enabled);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_source ON ai_roles(source);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_updated ON ai_roles(updated_at DESC);\n\n-- 创建触发器，自动更新updated_at字段\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_ai_roles_updated_at\nAFTER UPDATE ON ai_roles\nBEGIN\n    UPDATE ai_roles SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\nEND;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "// 公开访问接口（通过address获取配置和角色）\napp.get('/api/v1/public-by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { address } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAddress(address);\n    \n    if (!config) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\n    }\n\n    // 获取角色列表\n    let roles: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; config.workflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\n      if (workflow) {\n        try {\n          const workflowNodes = typeof workflow.nodes === 'string' \n            ? JSON.parse(workflow.nodes) \n            : workflow.nodes;\n          if (Array.isArray(workflowNodes)) {\n            const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n            const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n            roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n          }\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析工作流节点失败', { \n            workflowId: config.workflowId, \n            error: parseError \n          });\n          // 解析失败时返回空角色列表，不抛出错误\n        }\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled)\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts",
        "range": {

            "line": 13

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 1527,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行Agent节点\n   */\n  private async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const agentId = node.agentId || node.data?.agentId;\n    if (!agentId) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Agent节点 ${node.id} 未配置agentId&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 获取AI角色配置\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\n    if (!role) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!role.enabled) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色已禁用: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 准备输入数据\n    const nodeInput = this.prepareNodeInput(node, sharedContext);\n    \n    // 尝试从多个可能的字段中提取query\n    // 优先级：query &gt; input &gt; workflowInput.query &gt; 整个nodeInput的字符串化\n    let query = nodeInput.query;\n    if (!query) {\n      query = nodeInput.input;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.query) {\n      query = nodeInput.workflowInput.query;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; typeof nodeInput === 'object') {\n      // 如果还是没有，尝试从其他常见字段中提取\n      query = nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\n    }\n    if (!query) {\n      // 最后回退：如果nodeInput是字符串，直接使用；否则字符串化\n      query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\n    }\n    \n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\n    delete inputs.query;\n    delete inputs.input;\n\n    // 检查 provider 类型，Workflow 目前只支持 Dify\n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 是 Direct Agent 类型，不支持在 Workflow 中使用。请使用 Dify 类型的角色。&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 根据连接类型调用Dify API\n    if (!role.difyConfig) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\n    // 尝试从多个可能的位置获取 conversationId\n    // 优先级：nodeInput.conversationId &gt; nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId &gt; sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 根据节点类型查找匹配的AI角色\n * 优先匹配 source === 'independent-page' 的角色\n * \n * @param nodeType - 节点类型（如 'ai-search'）\n * @param roles - AI角色列表\n * @returns 匹配的AI角色，如果未找到返回null\n */\nexport function findAIRoleForNode(\n  nodeType: IndependentNodeType,\n  roles: AIRoleConfig[]\n): AIRoleConfig | null {\n  // 查找节点配置\n  const nodeConfig = INDEPENDENT_NODE_CONFIGS.find(config =&gt; config.nodeType === nodeType);\n  \n  if (!nodeConfig) {\n    console.warn(&#96;未找到节点类型配置: ${nodeType}&#96;);\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // 优先级1: 查找 source === 'independent-page' 且ID精确匹配的角色\n  for (const role of roles) {\n    if (role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;&amp; role.enabled) {\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&gt; pattern.test(role.id))) {\n        console.log(&#96;找到独立页面AI角色 (ID精确匹配): ${role.name}&#96;);\n        return role;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 优先级2: 查找 source === 'independent-page' 且名称匹配的角色\n  for (const role of roles) {\n    if (role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;&amp; role.enabled) {\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&gt; pattern.test(role.name))) {\n        console.log(&#96;找到独立页面AI角色 (名称匹配): ${role.name}&#96;);\n        return role;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 优先级3: 查找 source === 'independent-page' 且描述匹配的角色\n  for (const role of roles) {\n    if (role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;&amp; role.enabled) {\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&gt; pattern.test(role.description))) {\n        console.log(&#96;找到独立页面AI角色 (描述匹配): ${role.name}&#96;);\n        return role;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 优先级4: 回退到任意source的匹配（用于兼容性）\n  for (const role of roles) {\n    if (role.enabled) {\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&gt; \n        pattern.test(role.id) || \n        pattern.test(role.name) || \n        pattern.test(role.description)\n      )) {\n        console.warn(&#96;找到AI角色但source不匹配 (回退匹配): ${role.name}, source: ${role.source}&#96;);\n        return role;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  console.warn(&#96;未找到匹配的AI角色: ${nodeType}&#96;);\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * 获取节点类型配置\n * \n * @param nodeType - 节点类型\n * @returns 节点配置，如果未找到返回null\n */",
        "signatures": {},

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * 插入或更新AI角色\n */\nasync function upsertAIRole(\n  role: IndependentPageRole | SmartWorkflowRole,\n  source: 'independent-page' | 'smart-workflow',\n  connectionType: 'chatflow' | 'workflow' = 'chatflow'\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 检查角色是否已存在\n    const checkSql = 'SELECT id FROM ai_roles WHERE id = ?';\n    const existing = await db.query(checkSql, [role.id]);\n    \n    // 准备Dify配置\n    const difyConfig = {\n      apiUrl: DIFY_API_BASE_URL,\n      apiKey: role.apiKey,\n      connectionType: connectionType,\n    };\n    \n    if (existing.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 更新现有角色\n      const updateSql = &#96;\n        UPDATE ai_roles \n        SET name = ?, \n            description = ?, \n            dify_config = ?,\n            enabled = 1,\n            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        WHERE id = ?\n      &#96;;\n      \n      await db.query(updateSql, [\n        role.name,\n        role.description,\n        JSON.stringify(difyConfig),\n        role.id,\n      ]);\n      \n      console.log(&#96;🔄 更新角色: ${role.name} (${role.id})&#96;);\n    } else {\n      // 插入新角色\n      const insertSql = &#96;\n        INSERT INTO ai_roles (\n          id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,\n          created_at, updated_at\n        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n      &#96;;\n      \n      await db.query(insertSql, [\n        role.id,\n        role.name,\n        role.description,\n        null, // avatar\n        null, // system_prompt\n        JSON.stringify(difyConfig),\n        1, // enabled\n        source,\n      ]);\n      \n      console.log(&#96;✅ 创建角色: ${role.name} (${role.id})&#96;);\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(&#96;❌ 处理角色 ${role.name} (${role.id}) 失败:&#96;, error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 初始化所有AI角色配置\n */\nasync function initializeAIRoles(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  console.log('🚀 开始初始化AI角色配置...');\n}",

        "contents": "// 公开访问接口（通过token获取配置和角色）\napp.get('/api/v1/public/:token', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { token } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAccessToken(token);\n    \n    if (!config) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\n    }\n\n    // 获取角色列表\n    let roles: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; config.workflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\n      if (workflow) {\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    }\n    \n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\n      context: { metadata: { token: req.params.token } },\n    });\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\n      data: null\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 公开访问接口（通过address获取配置和角色）\napp.get",

        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取启用的AI角色\n   */\n  async getEnabled(): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig[]&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM ai_roles WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC';\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [];\n\n    // 安全转换，跳过有问题的记录\n    const roles: AIRoleConfig[] = [];\n    for (const row of rows) {\n      try {\n        const role = this.toAIRoleConfig(row as AIRole);\n        roles.push(role);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;转换AI角色失败 (ID: ${(row as any).id}):&#96;, error);\n        // 继续处理其他记录\n      }\n    }\n\n    return roles;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新AI角色\n   */\n  async update(id: string, data: UpdateAIRoleDTO): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\nprivate toAIRoleConfig(row: AIRole): AIRoleConfig {\n\n    \n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      // Direct Agent 配置\n      // 支持两种格式：{ provider: 'direct-agent', agentConfig: {...} } 或直接是 agentConfig\n      if (configData.agentConfig &amp;&amp; typeof configData.agentConfig === 'object') {\n        agentConfig = configData.agentConfig as DirectAgentConfig;\n      } else if (configData.llm &amp;&amp; typeof configData.llm === 'object') {\n        // 旧格式：直接包含 llm, prompt, contextStrategy 等\n        agentConfig = configData as DirectAgentConfig;\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Dify 配置（向后兼容）\n      // 检查是否包含 Dify 必需的字段，或者如果 configData 不为空，假设是 Dify 配置\n      if (configData &amp;&amp; (configData.apiUrl || configData.apiKey || configData.connectionType || Object.keys(configData).length &gt; 0)) {\n        // 确保包含必需的字段，如果没有则使用默认值\n        difyConfig = {\n          apiUrl: configData.apiUrl || '/api/dify/chat-messages',\n          apiKey: configData.apiKey || '',\n          connectionType: configData.connectionType || 'chatflow',\n          inputFields: configData.inputFields || []\n        } as DifyConfig;\n      } else {\n        // 如果完全没有配置，使用默认的 Dify 配置\n        difyConfig = {\n          apiUrl: '/api/dify/chat-messages',\n          apiKey: '',\n          connectionType: 'chatflow',\n          inputFields: []\n        };\n      }\n    }\n    \n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      name: row.name || '',\n      description: row.description || '',\n      avatar: row.avatar || undefined,\n      systemPrompt: row.system_prompt || undefined,\n      provider,\n      difyConfig,\n      agentConfig,\n      enabled: row.enabled === 1,\n      source: (row.source as any) || undefined,\n      createdAt: new Date(row.created_at || Date.now()),\n      updatedAt: new Date(row.updated_at || Date.now()),\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\n * 注意：这个路由必须在 /:id 之前定义，因为 Express 按顺序匹配路由\n */\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\n    \n    if (!config) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\n    }\n\n    let roles: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; config.workflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\n      if (workflow) {\n        try {\n          const workflowNodes = typeof workflow.nodes === 'string' \n            ? JSON.parse(workflow.nodes) \n            : workflow.nodes;\n          if (Array.isArray(workflowNodes)) {\n            const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\n            const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n            roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n          }\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          console.error('解析工作流节点失败', { \n            workflowId: config.workflowId, \n            error: parseError \n          });\n          // 解析失败时返回空角色列表，不抛出错误\n        }\n      }\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; config.roleIds &amp;&amp; config.roleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 获取指定的角色\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;&amp; r.enabled);\n    }\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '获取配置预览失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 切换配置启用状态\n * PATCH /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/toggle\n * 注意：这个路由必须在 /:id 之前定义，因为 Express 按顺序匹配路由\n */",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'FEATURE_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: &#96;未找到功能对象映射配置: ${dto.featureType}&#96;,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // 优先使用 agentId（AI角色ID），如果没有再使用 workflowId\n      // agentId 用于直接调用 AI 角色，workflowId 用于通过工作流调用\n      const configuredAgentId = (featureConfig as any).agentId;\n      const configuredWorkflowId = featureConfig.workflowId;\n      \n      // 如果配置了 agentId，使用它；否则使用 workflowId\n      // 注意：只有当 agentId 是不同的角色时才使用它，避免使用当前工作流\n      let targetWorkflowId: string;\n      if (configuredAgentId &amp;&amp; configuredAgentId !== workflowId) {\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredAgentId;\n        logger.info('使用配置的 AI 角色', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          agentId: configuredAgentId,\n        });\n      } else if (configuredWorkflowId &amp;&amp; configuredWorkflowId !== workflowId) {\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredWorkflowId;\n        logger.info('使用配置的工作流', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          workflowId: configuredWorkflowId,\n        });\n      } else {\n        targetWorkflowId = workflowId;\n        logger.warn('功能对象未配置专属 agentId 或 workflowId，将使用当前工作流', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          fallbackWorkflowId: workflowId,\n          configuredAgentId,\n          configuredWorkflowId,\n        });\n      }\n      const targetMappingConfig = targetWorkflowId === workflowId\n        ? baseMappingConfig\n        : await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, targetWorkflowId);\n\n      const effectiveInputMappings = featureConfig.inputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.inputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.inputMappings || [];\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversation = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(conversationId);\n      if (!conversation) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '对话不存在',\n        });\n      }\n\n      const requestedWorkflowId = dto.workflowId;\n      const workflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n      if (!workflowId) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n        });\n      }\n\n      let targetSources = Array.isArray(dto.sources) ? dto.sources : conversation.sources || [];\n\n      const baseMappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, workflowId);\n      if (!baseMappingConfig) {\n        const message =\n          requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === workflowId\n            ? &#96;所选工作流(${workflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n            : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n        return failure({\n          code: 'MAPPING_NOT_FOUND',\n          message,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const featureConfig = baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.find(\n        (f: FeatureObjectMapping) =&gt; f.featureType === dto.featureType\n      );\n\n      // 调试日志：检查功能对象配置\n      logger.info('查找功能对象配置', {\n        featureType: dto.featureType,\n        allFeatureObjects: baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.map((f: any) =&gt; ({\n          featureType: f.featureType,\n          workflowId: f.workflowId,\n          pageType: f.pageType,\n        })),\n        foundConfig: featureConfig ? {\n          featureType: featureConfig.featureType,\n          workflowId: featureConfig.workflowId,\n        } : null,\n      });\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\nconst loadExistingConfig = async \n\n        \n        if (targetPageType) {\n          console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 查找 pageType:', targetPageType);\n          \n          // 查找该 pageType 对应的第一个工作流配置\n          for (const mapping of mappingsData) {\n            const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \n              ? mapping.config.featureObjects \n              : [];\n            \n            const hasMatchingPageType = featureObjects.some((f: any) =&gt; \n              f.pageType === targetPageType\n            );\n            \n            if (hasMatchingPageType) {\n              console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 找到匹配的工作流:', mapping.workflowId);\n              setSelectedWorkflowId(mapping.workflowId);\n              \n              // 加载该 pageType 已配置的 AI 模块\n              const configuredFeatures = featureObjects\n                .filter((f: any) =&gt; f.pageType === targetPageType)\n                .map((f: any) =&gt; f.featureType);\n              \n              console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 已配置的 AI 模块:', configuredFeatures);\n              \n              if (configuredFeatures.length &gt; 0) {\n                setSelectedFeatureTypes(configuredFeatures);\n              }\n              return; // 找到配置后直接返回\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果没有找到配置，但有工作流，使用第一个工作流作为默认值\n        if (workflows.length &gt; 0) {\n          console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 使用默认工作流:', workflows[0].id);\n          setSelectedWorkflowId(workflows[0].id);\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 加载配置信息失败:', error);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadExistingConfig();\n    // 移除 selectedPageType 从依赖项，避免循环更新\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [showCreateModal, workflows, normalizedUrlPageType]);\n\n  const handleEdit = (mapping: FieldMappingListItem) =&gt;\n;\n;",

修改已完成。已将“选择工作流”改为“选择AI角色”。

## 修改总结

1. **新增状态管理**：
   - 添加 `selectedRoleIdForMapping` 状态，用于选择AI角色

2. **下拉框更改**：
   - 将“选择工作流”改为“选择AI角色”
   - 显示所有启用的AI角色列表
   - 选项格式：`角色名称 - 角色描述`

3. **逻辑更新**：
   - 使用选中的AI角色ID作为 `workflowId`（后端使用workflowId作为主键）
   - 加载现有配置时，尝试将workflowId映射回AI角色
   - 如果找不到匹配的角色，保持workflowId不变，但需要用户手动选择AI角色

4. **默认值处理**：
   - 如果没有选择AI角色，使用第一个启用的AI角色作为默认值
   - 如果没有可用的AI角色，显示提示信息

5. **错误提示**：
   - 将错误提示从“没有可用的工作流”改为“没有可用的AI角色”

现在用户可以通过选择AI角色来配置字段映射，而不是选择工作流。代码已更新，可以测试功能。

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst ;\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (projectId) {\n      // 从 localStorage 恢复已选择的技术点\n      try {\n        const stored = localStorage.getItem(&#96;project-${projectId}-selectedTechPoints&#96;);\n        if (stored) {\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);\n          if (Array.isArray(parsed) &amp;&amp; parsed.length &gt; 0) {\n            const validIds = parsed.filter((id: any) =&gt; typeof id === 'number');\n            if (validIds.length &gt; 0) {\n              setSelectedTechPoints(validIds);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('恢复已选择技术点失败:', error);\n      } finally {\n        setIsTechPointsLoaded(true);\n      }\n      \n      // 恢复对话记录（如果在初始化时未恢复）\n      if (aiMessages.length === 0) {\n        try {\n          const stored = localStorage.getItem(&#96;project-${projectId}-ai-messages&#96;);\n          if (stored) {\n            const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);\n            const restored = parsed.map((msg: any) =&gt; ({\n              ...msg,\n              timestamp: new Date(msg.timestamp)\n            }));\n            if (restored.length &gt; 0) {\n              setAiMessages(restored);\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('恢复对话记录失败:', error);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      loadProject();\n      loadSources();\n      loadTechPoints();\n      loadPublicKnowledgeFiles();\n      checkHistoryRecords(false); // 检查历史记录，但不自动切换视图\n    }\n  }, [projectId]);\n\n  // 持久化已选择的技术点到 localStorage\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (projectId &amp;&amp; isTechPointsLoaded) {\n      try {\n        localStorage.setItem(&#96;project-${projectId}-selectedTechPoints&#96;, JSON.stringify(selectedTechPoints));\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('保存已选择技术点失败:', error);\n      }\n    }\n  }, [selectedTechPoints, projectId, isTechPointsLoaded]);\n\n  // 持久化对话记录到 localStorage\n;",

        "contents": "class DocumentService {\n  private readonly STORAGE_KEY = 'todify3_documents';\n\n  // 保存文档到本地存储\n  saveDocument(document: DocumentData): DocumentData {\n    try {\n      const documents = this.getAllDocuments();\n      const now = new Date();\n      \n      if (document.id) {\n        // 更新现有文档\n        const index = documents.findIndex(doc =&gt; doc.id === document.id);\n        if (index !== -1) {\n          documents[index] = {\n            ...document,\n            updatedAt: now\n          };\n        }\n      } else {\n        // 创建新文档\n        document.id = this.generateId();\n        document.createdAt = now;\n        document.updatedAt = now;\n        documents.push(document);\n      }\n\n      localStorage.setItem(this.STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(documents));\n      return document;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('保存文档失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('保存文档失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 获取所有文档\n  getAllDocuments(): DocumentData[] {\n    try\n  }",

        "contents": "const MultiChatContainer: React.FC&lt;MultiChatContainerProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 从localStorage加载配置\n  const loadConfig = () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const configStr = localStorage.getItem('multiChatWorkflowConfig');\n      if (configStr) {\n        const config = JSON.parse(configStr);\n        setSelectedWorkflowId(config.workflowId || '');\n        setSelectedRoleIds(config.roleIds || []);\n        setDisplayMode(config.displayMode || 'all');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载配置失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (embedded &amp;&amp; initialWorkflowId) {\n      setSelectedWorkflowId(initialWorkflowId);\n      setDisplayMode('workflow');\n    }\n  }, [embedded, initialWorkflowId]);\n\n  // 当配置或所有角色变化时，更新显示的角色\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    let filteredRoles: AIRoleConfig[] = [];\n\n    if (displayMode === 'all') {\n      // 显示所有启用的角色\n      filteredRoles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; selectedWorkflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const workflow = workflows.find(w =&gt; w.id === selectedWorkflowId);\n      if (workflow &amp;&amp; workflow.nodes) {\n        const workflowAgentIds = workflow.nodes\n          .flatMap(node =&gt; extractAgentIdsFromNode(node))\n          .filter(Boolean);\n        const uniqueAgentIds = Array.from(new Set(workflowAgentIds));\n        filteredRoles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; \n          r.enabled &amp;&amp; uniqueAgentIds.includes(r.id)\n        );\n      }\n    } else if (displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; selectedRoleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 只显示选定的角色\n      filteredRoles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; \n        r.enabled &amp;&amp; selectedRoleIds.includes(r.id)\n      );\n    }\n\n    setRoles(filteredRoles);\n  }, [allRoles, displayMode, selectedWorkflowId, selectedRoleIds, workflows]);\n  \n  // 加载工作流列表\n  const loadWorkflows = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const PublicPageConfigManagementPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 处理模板选择\n  const handleTemplateSelect = (templateType: 'speech' | 'ai-chat' | 'ai-chat-edit' | 'ai-chat-knowledge' | 'ai-chat-source' | 'ai-chat-source-tools' | 'custom' | null) =&gt; {\n    if (templateType &amp;&amp; templateType !== 'custom' &amp;&amp; TEMPLATES[templateType]) {\n      setFormData({\n        ...formData,\n        templateType,\n        customHtml: TEMPLATES[templateType],\n      });\n    } else if (templateType === null) {\n      setFormData({\n        ...formData,\n        templateType: null,\n        customHtml: '',\n      });\n    } else {\n      setFormData({\n        ...formData,\n        templateType: 'custom',\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSave = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const saveData = {\n        name: formData.name,\n        description: formData.description,\n        templateType: formData.templateType,\n        customHtml: formData.customHtml,\n      };\n      \n      if (editingConfig) {\n        await publicPageConfigService.updateConfig(editingConfig.id, saveData);\n      } else {\n        await publicPageConfigService.createConfig(saveData);\n      }\n      setShowModal(false);\n      loadConfigs();\n      \n      // 触发配置更新事件，通知导航栏更新\n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 触发配置更新事件');\n      const event = new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigUpdated', {\n        detail: { configId: editingConfig?.id, timestamp: Date.now() }\n      });\n      window.dispatchEvent(event);\n      \n      // 同时使用localStorage作为备用通知机制\n      const refreshKey = 'publicPageConfigsRefresh';\n      const oldValue = localStorage.getItem(refreshKey);\n      const newValue = Date.now().toString();\n      localStorage.setItem(refreshKey, newValue);\n      \n      // 触发自定义事件（用于同标签页通信）\n      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('publicPageConfigsRefresh', {\n        detail: { key: refreshKey, oldValue, newValue }\n      }));\n      \n      console.log('[ConfigPage] 配置已保存，事件已触发');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('保存失败:', error);\n      alert('保存失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id: string)\n;\n;",

修改已完成。总结如下：

## 修改总结

已实现自定义AI模块的持久化存储，使其在关闭弹窗后重新打开时仍显示在列表中。

### 主要修改：

1. **添加localStorage存储功能**：
   - 定义 `CUSTOM_MODULES_STORAGE_KEY` 常量用于存储键
   - 创建 `loadCustomModulesFromStorage()` 函数从localStorage加载自定义模块
   - 创建 `saveCustomModulesToStorage()` 函数保存自定义模块到localStorage

2. **组件初始化时加载**：
   - 在 `useEffect` 中，组件加载时从localStorage读取已保存的自定义模块

3. **弹窗打开时加载**：
   - 弹窗打开时从localStorage加载自定义模块
   - 确保每次打开弹窗都能看到之前添加的自定义模块

4. **添加模块时保存**：
   - 添加新模块时，立即保存到localStorage
   - 确保数据持久化

5. **删除模块时更新**：
   - 删除模块时，更新localStorage
   - 确保删除操作被持久化

6. **保持持久化**：
   - 移除了所有会重置 `customModules` 的代码
   - 弹窗关闭和保存成功后，自定义模块仍然保留

### 功能特点：

- 持久化存储：自定义模块保存在localStorage中
- 自动加载：每次打开弹窗时自动加载已保存的模块
- 实时同步：添加或删除模块时立即更新localStorage
- 跨会话保持：即使刷新页面或重新打开应用，自定义模块仍然存在

现在，用户添加的自定义AI模块（如"用户场景"）会一直显示在"选择AI模块"的网格列表中，不会因为关闭弹窗而消失。

        "contents": "const AIRoleConfigInfoBox: React.FC&lt;AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps&gt; = \nconst handleCreateAndAssignRole = async \n\n\n      // 2. 尝试自动分配给第一个字段映射配置\n      try {\n        const configs = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n        if (configs.length &gt; 0) {\n          let updated = false;\n          for (const configItem of configs) {\n            const featureObjects = configItem.config.featureObjects || [];\n            const featureIndex = featureObjects.findIndex((f: any) =&gt; f.featureType === featureType);\n            \n            if (featureIndex &gt;= 0) {\n              // 更新现有的 feature object\n              featureObjects[featureIndex] = {\n                ...featureObjects[featureIndex],\n                agentId: result.role.id\n              };\n              \n              await aiSearchService.saveFieldMappingConfig(configItem.workflowId, {\n                ...configItem.config,\n                featureObjects\n              });\n              updated = true;\n            }\n          }\n          \n          if (updated) {\n            if (onRefresh) onRefresh();\n            loadNodeStatuses(); // 重新加载状态\n          } else {\n             alert(&#96;角色 \"${result.role.name}\" 已创建，但在现有字段映射配置中未找到对应功能项。请前往配置页面手动添加。&#96;);\n             if (onRefresh) onRefresh();\n          }\n        } else {\n            alert(&#96;角色 \"${result.role.name}\" 已创建。由于没有字段映射配置，无法自动分配。&#96;);\n            if (onRefresh) onRefresh();\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error('分配角色失败:', e);\n        alert(&#96;角色 \"${result.role.name}\" 已创建，但在自动分配时发生错误。请手动配置。&#96;);\n        if (onRefresh) onRefresh();\n      }\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('操作失败:', error);\n      alert('操作失败，请查看控制台日志');\n    } finally {\n      setCreatingRole(null);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleOpenSelector = (status: NodeConfigStatus) =&gt;\n;\n;",

            "column": 3
          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * 保存字段映射配置\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/field-mappings/:workflowId\n */\nrouter.post('/field-mappings/:workflowId', ensureTablesInitialized, async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { workflowId } = req.params;\n    const dto = validateDTO(SaveFieldMappingSchema, req.body);\n    const result = await saveFieldMappingConfigUseCase.execute(workflowId, dto);\n\n    if (!result.success) {\n      const status = result.error.code === 'WORKFLOW_ID_MISMATCH' ? 400 : 500;\n      return res.status(status).json(\n        formatApiResponse(false, null, '保存字段映射配置失败', result.error.message)\n      );\n    }\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result.value, '保存字段映射配置成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\n      const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\n      return res.status(400).json(failure);\n    }\n\n    logger.error('保存字段映射配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '保存字段映射配置失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除字段映射配置\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/field-mappings/:workflowId\n */",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversation = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(conversationId);\n      if (!conversation) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '对话不存在',\n        });\n      }\n\n      const requestedWorkflowId = dto.workflowId;\n      const workflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n      if (!workflowId) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n        });\n      }\n\n      let targetSources = Array.isArray(dto.sources) ? dto.sources : conversation.sources || [];\n\n      const baseMappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, workflowId);\n      if (!baseMappingConfig) {\n        const message =\n          requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === workflowId\n            ? &#96;所选工作流(${workflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n            : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n        return failure({\n          code: 'MAPPING_NOT_FOUND',\n          message,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const featureConfig = baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.find(\n        (f: FeatureObjectMapping) =&gt; f.featureType === dto.featureType\n      );\n\n      // 调试日志：检查功能对象配置\n      logger.info('查找功能对象配置', {\n        featureType: dto.featureType,\n        allFeatureObjects: baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.map((f: any) =&gt; ({\n          featureType: f.featureType,\n          workflowId: f.workflowId,\n          pageType: f.pageType,\n        })),\n        foundConfig: featureConfig ? {\n          featureType: featureConfig.featureType,\n          workflowId: featureConfig.workflowId,\n        } : null,\n      });\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return\n  }\n}",

修改已完成。总结如下：

## 修改总结

已修复重复创建配置的问题，更新机制如下：

### 主要修改：

1. **数据加载时去重**：
   - 在 `loadData` 函数中添加去重逻辑
   - 使用 `Set` 跟踪已见过的配置
   - 唯一键：`workflowId + pageType + featureType`
   - 如果发现重复配置，会跳过并记录警告日志

2. **保存时去重**：
   - 在保存逻辑中使用 `Map` 确保每个 `featureType` 只保留一个配置
   - 避免在同一个 `pageType` 下创建重复的 `featureType` 配置
   - 保留原有配置信息（如 `inputMappings`、`outputMappings`、`agentId`）

3. **更新机制优化**：
   - 保存时先移除当前 `pageType` 的所有配置
   - 然后根据用户选择重新创建配置
   - 确保每次保存都是完整的更新，而不是追加

### 解决的问题：

- 避免重复显示：在加载数据时自动去重
- 避免重复创建：在保存时确保每个 `featureType` 只有一个配置
- 正确更新：每次保存都会替换当前 `pageType` 的配置，而不是追加

### 工作流程：

1. 用户选择AI角色和页面类型
2. 选择要配置的AI模块
3. 点击"保存修改"
4. 系统会：
   - 获取现有配置
   - 保留其他 `pageType` 的配置
   - 替换当前 `pageType` 的配置（去重）
   - 保存并重新加载数据
   - 显示更新后的配置列表（无重复）

现在修改配置时不会再出现重复创建的问题，每次保存都会正确更新现有配置。

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const reportError = useCallback((message: string, detail?: unknown) =&gt; {\n    setGlobalError(message);\n    if (!detail) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(null);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (typeof detail === \"string\") {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (detail instanceof Error) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail.message);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(JSON.stringify(detail));\n    } catch {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(String(detail));\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const updateTriggerStatus = (message: string | null, duration = 0) =&gt; {\n    if (triggerStatusTimerRef.current) {\n      window.clearTimeout(triggerStatusTimerRef.current);\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n    }\n\n    setTriggeringStatus(message);\n\n    if (message &amp;&amp; duration &gt; 0) {\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        setTriggeringStatus(null);\n        triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n      }, duration);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 获取项目ID和是否创建新对话的标志\n  const projectId = searchParams.get('projectId');\n  const shouldCreateNewConversation = searchParams.get('newConversation') === 'true';\n  \n  // 根据项目ID调整 pageType，确保不同项目的对话相互独立\n  // 项目隔离规则：\n  // - 非关联项目（无 projectId）：使用默认 pageType（如 tech-package、tech-strategy、tech-article）\n  // - 关联项目（有 projectId）：使用 pageType-project-{projectId}（如 tech-package-project-3）\n  // 这样确保不同项目下的技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿的对话、记录、来源信息等都保持独立\n  const effectivePageType = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    if (projectId) {\n      // 如果有项目ID，使用项目特定的 pageType，例如：tech-package-project-3\n      return &#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&#96;;\n    }\n    // 无项目ID时，使用默认 pageType，对应\"非关联项目\"\n    return config.pageType;\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n;",

        "contents": "const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\n 'field-mapping-management'\n];\n\n/**\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\n */\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { address } = useParams&lt;{ address: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  // 加载公开页面配置\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!address) {\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setConfigLoading(true);\n        setError(null);\n        // 根据地址查找配置\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\n        if (configData &amp;&amp; configData.config) {\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\n        } else {\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\n        }\n      } catch (err: any) {\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\n          navigate('/');\n          return;\n        }\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\n      } finally {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadPublicConfig();\n  }, [address, navigate]);\n\n  // 处理节点执行\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadFiles = \n, [effectivePageType]);\n\n  // 加载对话历史和输出内容\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 如果 URL 中有 newConversation 参数，清除当前对话，确保创建新对话\n    if (shouldCreateNewConversation &amp;&amp; currentConversation) {\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 检测到 newConversation 参数，清除当前对话');\n      setCurrentConversation(null);\n      // 清除 URL 参数，避免刷新时重复清除\n      const newSearchParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);\n      newSearchParams.delete('newConversation');\n      setSearchParams(newSearchParams, { replace: true });\n    }\n    \n    loadConversations();\n    loadOutputs();\n    loadWorkflowConfig();\n    loadFiles();\n    \n    // 加载页面类型的来源信息（始终加载，作为基础来源）\n    loadPageTypeSources();\n    \n    const handleFilesUploaded = () =&gt; {\n      loadFiles();\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('filesUploaded', handleFilesUploaded);\n    \n    return () =&gt; {\n      window.removeEventListener('filesUploaded', handleFilesUploaded);\n    };\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, []);\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\n  };\n\n  const loadAvailableWorkflows = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(true);\n      const list = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n      setAvailableWorkflows(list);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"加载工作流列表失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"加载工作流列表失败\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n    } finally {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [reportError]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadAvailableWorkflows();\n  }, [loadAvailableWorkflows]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&gt;\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst [defaultWorkflowFromMapping, setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping] = &lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadDefaultWorkflowFromMapping = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const mappings = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n        // 查找该 pageType 对应的第一个工作流（作为默认工作流）\n        // 支持向后兼容：press-release 也匹配 speech\n        const pageKeys = config.pageType === 'press-release' \n          ? ['press-release', 'speech'] \n          : [config.pageType];\n        \n        for (const mapping of mappings) {\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \n            ? mapping.config.featureObjects \n            : [];\n          \n          // 查找第一个匹配当前 pageType 的 featureObject，使用其 workflowId 作为默认工作流\n          const matchedFeature = featureObjects.find((f: any) =&gt; \n            f.pageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(f.pageType)\n          );\n          \n          if (matchedFeature) {\n            const workflowId = matchedFeature.workflowId || mapping.workflowId;\n            // 验证工作流是否在可用列表中\n            if (availableWorkflows.some(w =&gt; w.id === workflowId)) {\n              setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(workflowId);\n              console.log(&#96;[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到 ${config.pageType} 的默认工作流:&#96;, workflowId);\n              return;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果没有找到匹配的，尝试使用该工作流配置中的第一个工作流\n        // 查找所有为该 pageType 配置的工作流，使用第一个\n        const allWorkflowsForPage = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n        for (const mapping of mappings) {\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects)\n;\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n  const loadPageTypeSources = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID），确保项目隔离\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载页面类型来源信息:', effectivePageType);\n      const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType(effectivePageType);\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载结果:', {\n        success: sourceResult.success,\n        count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n        error: sourceResult.error\n      });\n      \n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          // 只保留文件来源（file_开头的），然后添加当前页面的来源\n          // 这样可以确保切换页面时只显示当前页面的来源\n          const fileSources = prev.filter(s =&gt; s.id.startsWith('file_'));\n          const pageTypeSources = sourceResult.data!;\n          \n          // 合并文件来源和页面类型来源\n          const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n          fileSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          pageTypeSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          \n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n            fileSources: fileSources.length,\n            pageTypeSources: pageTypeSources.length\n          });\n          return merged;\n        });\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\n        // 即使加载失败，也要清除其他页面的来源，只保留文件来源\n  };\n;",

        },
        "contents": "# 项目节点配置需求与有效节点分析\n\n本文档详细分析了项目中需要配置的节点类型，以及前端页面中实际使用的有效节点。\n\n## 一、需要配置的节点类型\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点（5个）\n\n这些节点对应独立的页面路由，需要配置AI角色（source: 'independent-page'）：\n\n| 节点ID | 节点名称 | 路由路径 | 页面组件 | 状态 |\n|--------|---------|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;ai-search&#96; | AI问答 | &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | AiSearchNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | TechPackageNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;promotion-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | PromotionStrategyNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;core-draft&#96; | 核心稿件 | &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | CoreDraftNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;speech&#96; | 演讲稿 | &#96;/node/speech&#96; | PressReleasePage | ✅ 有效（映射到press-release） |\n\n**配置要求：**\n- 需要在AI角色管理系统中创建对应的AI角色\n- source必须设置为 &#96;'independent-page'&#96;\n- 角色ID或名称需要匹配节点类型（通过正则表达式匹配）\n- 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\n\n**匹配规则（见 &#96;nodeRoleMapping.ts&#96;）：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ai-search 匹配模式\n/ai-search/i, /ai问答/i, /智能搜索/i, /smart-search/i\n\n// tech-package 匹配模式\n/tech-package/i, /技术包装/i\n\n// promotion-strategy 匹配模式\n/promotion-strategy/i, /tech-strategy/i, /技术策略/i, /推广策略/i\n\n// core-draft 匹配模式\n/core-draft/i, /tech-article/i, /技术通稿/i, /核心稿件/i\n\n// speech 匹配模式\n/speech/i, /发布会/i, /演讲稿/i, /tech-publish/i\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 标准页面节点（5个）\n\n这些是标准化的独立页面，使用BaseAISearchPage组件：\n\n| 页面类型 | 页面名称 | 路由路径 | 配置文件 | 状态 |\n|---------|---------|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/tech-package&#96; | techPackageConfig | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | techStrategyConfig | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-article&#96; | 技术通稿 | &#96;/tech-article&#96; | techArticleConfig | ✅ 有效 |",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "const AddressPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 如果配置的模板类型是 speech，使用发布会稿页面\n  if (publicConfig.config.templateType === 'speech') {\n    return &lt;PressReleasePage /&gt;;\n  }\n\n  // 默认使用技术包装页面（如果模板类型是 tech-package 或其他）\n  if (publicConfig.config.templateType === 'tech-package') {\n    return &lt;TechPackagePage /&gt;;\n  }\n\n  // 如果没有指定模板类型，默认使用技术包装页面\n  return &lt;TechPackagePage /&gt;;\n\n  // 其他模板类型可以在这里扩展\n  return (\n    &lt;PageTransition isVisible={true}&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-center\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4\"&gt;模版类型不支持&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"text-gray-600 mb-4\"&gt;\n            当前配置的模版类型暂不支持显示\n          &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;button\n            onClick={() =&gt; navigate(\"/\")}\n            className=\"px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700\"\n          &gt;\n            返回首页\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/PageTransition&gt;\n  );\n};\n\nexport default AddressPage;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversations = async (options?: { refreshActive?: boolean; activeConversationId?: string }) =&gt; {\n\n      setConversations(uniqueConversations);\n\n      if (uniqueConversations.length === 0) {\n        setCurrentConversation(null);\n        // 如果没有对话，确保加载页面类型的来源信息\n        await loadPageTypeSources();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 确定要激活的对话ID\n      let activeId = options?.activeConversationId;\n      \n      // 如果没有指定，尝试保持当前对话（如果在列表中）\n      if (!activeId &amp;&amp; currentConversationRef.current?.id) {\n        const currentId = currentConversationRef.current.id;\n        if (uniqueConversations.some(c =&gt; c.id === currentId)) {\n          activeId = currentId;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 如果还是没有，默认选中第一个\n      if (!activeId) {\n        activeId = uniqueConversations[0].id;\n      }\n\n      if (!activeId) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const current = currentConversationRef.current;\n      if (\n        !current ||\n        options?.refreshActive ||\n        current.id !== activeId\n      ) {\n        await loadConversationDetail(activeId);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"加载对话历史失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"加载对话历史失败，请稍后重试\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n    }\n  }, [loadConversationDetail, reportError, loadPageTypeSources, effectivePageType]);\n\n  const loadOutputs = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\n      const data = await aiSearchService.getOutputs(undefined, effectivePageType);\n      setOutputs(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"加载输出内容失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"加载输出内容失败，请稍后重试\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 当页面类型或项目ID变化时，重新加载所有信息\n;",

        "contents": "### 2. 页面组件映射\n\n| 页面路由 | 页面组件 | 使用的节点组件 | 配置来源 |\n|---------|---------|--------------|---------|\n| &#96;/tech-package&#96; | TechPackagePage | BaseAISearchPage | techPackageConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | TechStrategyPage | BaseAISearchPage | techStrategyConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-article&#96; | TechArticlePage | BaseAISearchPage | techArticleConfig |\n| &#96;/press-release&#96; | PressReleasePage | BaseAISearchPage | pressReleaseConfig |\n| &#96;/ai-qa&#96; | AIQAPage | BaseAISearchPage | aiQaConfig |\n| &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/ai-qa&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | NodePage | TechPackageNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | NodePage | PromotionStrategyNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | NodePage | CoreDraftNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/speech&#96; | NodePage | PressReleasePage | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n\n### 3. 工作流编辑器节点\n\n工作流编辑器（&#96;/agent-workflow&#96;）中可用的节点类型：\n\n| 节点类型 | 是否有效 | 使用场景 |\n|---------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;agent&#96; | ✅ 是 | 调用AI角色执行任务 |\n| &#96;input&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输入 |\n| &#96;output&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输出 |\n| &#96;condition&#96; | ✅ 是 | 条件分支判断 |\n| &#96;assign&#96; | ✅ 是 | 变量赋值 |\n| &#96;merge&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据合并 |\n| &#96;transform&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据转换 |\n| &#96;memory&#96; | ✅ 是 | 文本存储 |\n\n## 三、节点配置依赖关系\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点配置流程\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. 创建AI角色\n   ├─ source: 'independent-page'\n   ├─ provider: 'dify' 或 'direct-agent'\n   └─ 名称/ID匹配节点类型\n\n2. 配置Dify连接（如果provider为dify）\n   ├─ connectionType: 'chatflow' 或 'workflow'\n   ├─ apiKey: Dify API密钥\n   └─ apiUrl: Dify服务器地址\n\n3. 配置Direct Agent（如果provider为direct-agent）\n   ├─ LLM配置（apiKey, apiBaseUrl, model）",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n() =&gt; {\nconst loadDefaultWorkflowFromMapping = async \n\n        for (const mapping of mappings) {\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \n            ? mapping.config.featureObjects \n            : [];\n          \n          const hasMatchingPageType = featureObjects.some((f: any) =&gt; \n            f.pageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(f.pageType)\n          );\n          \n          if (hasMatchingPageType) {\n            allWorkflowsForPage.add(mapping.workflowId);\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 使用第一个匹配的工作流\n        if (allWorkflowsForPage.size &gt; 0) {\n          const firstWorkflowId = Array.from(allWorkflowsForPage)[0];\n          if (availableWorkflows.some(w =&gt; w.id === firstWorkflowId)) {\n            setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(firstWorkflowId);\n            console.log(&#96;[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到 ${config.pageType} 的默认工作流（使用工作流配置）:&#96;, firstWorkflowId);\n            return;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(null);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载字段映射配置失败:', error);\n        setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(null);\n      }\n    };\n\n    if (availableWorkflows.length &gt; 0) {\n      loadDefaultWorkflowFromMapping();\n    }\n  }, [config.pageType, availableWorkflows]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const selectionMap = workflowSelectionRef.current;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingConfigManager: React.FC = \nconst openAgentModal = \n\n  };\n\n  const saveAgentRole = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!editingMappingForAgent) return;\n    try {\n      const existing = await aiSearchService.getFieldMappingConfig(editingMappingForAgent.workflowId);\n      if (!existing) {\n        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '配置不存在' });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const featureObjects = Array.isArray(existing.featureObjects) ? existing.featureObjects.slice() : [];\n      const featureIndex = featureObjects.findIndex(f =&gt; f.featureType === editingMappingForAgent.featureType);\n      \n      if (featureIndex &gt;= 0) {\n        // 更新现有featureObject的agentId\n        featureObjects[featureIndex] = {\n          ...featureObjects[featureIndex],\n          agentId: selectedAgentId || undefined,\n        };\n      } else {\n        // 如果不存在，创建一个新的featureObject\n        featureObjects.push({\n          featureType: editingMappingForAgent.featureType as any,\n          workflowId: editingMappingForAgent.workflowId,\n          inputMappings: [],\n          outputMappings: [],\n          pageType: (editingMappingForAgent.pageName === '技术包装' ?         "contents": "|---------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;five-view-analysis&#96; | 技术转译（五看） | 字段映射管理页面 |\n| &#96;three-fix-analysis&#96; | 用户场景挖掘（三定） | 字段映射管理页面 |\n| &#96;tech-matrix&#96; | 技术矩阵 | 字段映射管理页面 |\n| &#96;propagation-strategy&#96; | 传播策略 | 字段映射管理页面 |\n| &#96;exhibition-video&#96; | 展具与视频 | 字段映射管理页面 |\n| &#96;translation&#96; | 翻译 | 字段映射管理页面 |\n| &#96;ppt-outline&#96; | 技术讲稿 | 字段映射管理页面 |\n| &#96;script&#96; | 脚本 | 字段映射管理页面 |\n\n**配置方法**：\n1. 进入字段映射管理页面（&#96;/field-mapping-management&#96;）\n2. 选择对应的工作流\n3. 在功能对象配置中，为每个功能对象设置agentId\n4. agentId可以是AI角色ID（以&#96;role_&#96;或&#96;ai-role-&#96;开头）或工作流ID（以&#96;wf_&#96;开头）\n\n**相关代码位置**：\n- &#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&#96; - 触发Agent逻辑\n- &#96;frontend/src/pages/FieldMappingManagementPage.tsx&#96; - 字段映射管理页面\n\n## 二、配置优先级\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点匹配优先级\n\n系统按以下优先级匹配AI角色：\n\n1. **优先级1**：source === 'independent-page' 且ID精确匹配\n2. **优先级2**：source === 'independent-page' 且名称匹配\n3. **优先级3**：source === 'independent-page' 且描述匹配\n4. **优先级4**：回退到任意source的匹配（用于兼容性）\n\n### 2. 字段映射功能对象配置优先级\n\n在触发子Agent时，系统按以下优先级选择：\n\n1. **优先级1**：功能对象配置的agentId（如果存在且不同于当前工作流ID）\n2. **优先级2**：功能对象配置的workflowId（如果存在且不同于当前工作流ID）\n3. **优先级3**：回退到当前工作流ID\n\n## 三、配置检查\n\n### 1. 自动检查\n\n在AI角色管理页面（&#96;/ai-roles&#96;）的信息框中，系统会自动检查：\n\n- ✅ 独立页面节点的配置状态\n- ⚠️ 工作流Agent节点的配置提示\n- ⚠️ 字段映射功能对象的配置提示\n\n### 2. 手动检查",

            "column": 1

        },
        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversation = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(conversationId);\n      if (!conversation) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '对话不存在',\n        });\n      }\n\n      const requestedWorkflowId = dto.workflowId;\n      const workflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n      if (!workflowId) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n        });\n      }\n\n      let targetSources = Array.isArray(dto.sources) ? dto.sources : conversation.sources || [];\n\n      const baseMappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, workflowId);\n      if (!baseMappingConfig) {\n        const message =\n          requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === workflowId\n            ? &#96;所选工作流(${workflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n            : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n        return failure({\n          code: 'MAPPING_NOT_FOUND',\n          message,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const featureConfig = baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.find(\n        (f: FeatureObjectMapping) =&gt; f.featureType === dto.featureType\n      );\n\n      // 调试日志：检查功能对象配置\n      logger.info('查找功能对象配置', {\n        featureType: dto.featureType,\n        allFeatureObjects: baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.map((f: any) =&gt; ({\n          featureType: f.featureType,\n          workflowId: f.workflowId,\n          pageType: f.pageType,\n        })),\n        foundConfig: featureConfig ? {\n          featureType: featureConfig.featureType,\n          workflowId: featureConfig.workflowId,\n        } : null,\n      });\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {

        "contents": "import { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nexport class GetFieldMappingConfigUseCase {\n  constructor(private readonly fieldMappingService: FieldMappingService) {}\n\n  async execute(workflowId: string): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const config = await this.fieldMappingService.getFieldMappingConfig(workflowId);\n\n      if (!config) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'FIELD_MAPPING_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '字段映射配置不存在',\n        });\n      }\n\n      return success(config);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取字段映射配置失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'GET_FIELD_MAPPING_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取字段映射配置失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {},

          }
        },
        "contents": "// 生产环境静态文件服务：直接从 frontend/dist 提供资源\n// 注意：必须在 API 路由之后，否则会拦截 API 请求\n// 仅在非开发环境或明确需要时才启用静态文件服务\nconst isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';\nif (!isDev) {\n  const distDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../frontend/dist');\n  app.use(express.static(distDir, {\n    maxAge: 0,\n    etag: true,\n    lastModified: true,\n  }));\n\n  // SPA Fallback：除 /api/* 外的所有路由都返回 index.html\n  app.get(/^(\\/(?!api).*)$/, (_req, res) =&gt; {\n    res.sendFile(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'));\n  });\n}\n\n// 全局错误处理中间件\n// 注意：这个中间件必须放在所有路由之后，且必须有4个参数 (err, req, res, next)\napp.use((err: any, req: any, res: any, next: any) =&gt; {\n  // 如果响应已经发送，则委托给默认的 Express 错误处理\n  if (res.headersSent) {\n    return next(err);\n  }\n\n  // 记录错误详情\n  logger.error('全局错误处理', {\n    error: err,\n    stack: err?.stack,\n    requestUrl: req.url,\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\n    method: req.method,\n    path: req.path,\n    body: req.body,\n    params: req.params,\n    query: req.query,\n  });\n\n  // 发送到错误追踪\n  errorTracking.captureException(\n    err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)),\n    {\n      context: {\n        metadata: {\n          method: req.method,\n          path: req.path,\n          body: req.body,\n          params: req.params,\n          query: req.query,\n        },\n      },\n    }\n  );\n\n  // 根据错误类型返回不同的状态码\n  const statusCode = err.statusCode || err.status || 500;\n  const errorMessage =\n    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'\n      ? '服务器内部错误'\n      : err.message || 'Unknown error';\n\n  res.status(statusCode).json({\n    success: false,\n    message: 'Internal server error',\n    error: errorMessage,\n    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' &amp;&amp; { stack: err?.stack }),\n  });\n});\n\n// 启动服务器前测试数据库连接\nasync function startServer() {\n  try\n}",

        },
        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const reportError = useCallback((message: string, detail?: unknown) =&gt; {\n    setGlobalError(message);\n    if (!detail) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(null);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (typeof detail === \"string\") {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (detail instanceof Error) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail.message);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(JSON.stringify(detail));\n    } catch {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(String(detail));\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const updateTriggerStatus = (message: string | null, duration = 0) =&gt; {\n    if (triggerStatusTimerRef.current) {\n      window.clearTimeout(triggerStatusTimerRef.current);\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n    }\n\n    setTriggeringStatus(message);\n\n    if (message &amp;&amp; duration &gt; 0) {\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        setTriggeringStatus(null);\n        triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n      }, duration);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 获取项目ID和是否创建新对话的标志\n  const projectId = searchParams.get('projectId');\n  const shouldCreateNewConversation = searchParams.get('newConversation') === 'true';\n  \n  // 根据项目ID调整 pageType，确保不同项目的对话相互独立\n  // 项目隔离规则：\n  // - 非关联项目（无 projectId）：使用默认 pageType（如 tech-package、tech-strategy、tech-article）\n  // - 关联项目（有 projectId）：使用 pageType-project-{projectId}（如 tech-package-project-3）\n  // 这样确保不同项目下的技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿的对话、记录、来源信息等都保持独立\n  const effectivePageType = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    if (projectId) {\n      // 如果有项目ID，使用项目特定的 pageType，例如：tech-package-project-3\n      return &#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&#96;;\n    }\n    // 无项目ID时，使用默认 pageType，对应\"非关联项目\"\n    return config.pageType;\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n;",

        "contents": "export class TechPressController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术通稿详情\n   */\n  async getById(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const pressRelease = await techPressReleaseModel.findById(id);\n      if (!pressRelease) {\n        return res.status(404).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '技术通稿不存在'\n        });\n      }\n\n      // 获取关联的对话和来源\n      const [conversations, sources] = await Promise.all([\n        techPressReleaseModel.getConversations(id),\n        techPressReleaseModel.getSources(id)\n      ]);\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: {\n          ...pressRelease,\n          conversations,\n          sources\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Get tech press release error:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取技术通稿失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新技术通稿\n   */\n  async update(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

已优化代码，确保即使 workflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 也能正确显示名称。

## 修改总结

1. **优化显示名称逻辑**：
   - 在 `loadData` 中，如果找不到对应的工作流，会尝试从 AI 角色中查找
   - 确保显示正确的名称（工作流名称或 AI 角色名称）
   - 避免显示"未知工作流"

2. **关于 404 错误**：
   - `tech-package:1 Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404` 通常是浏览器加载静态资源（如 favicon.ico）失败
   - 从日志看，配置加载正常：
     - `[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置加载工具，pageKeys: Array(1) mappings数量: 1`
     - `[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到的工具数量: 5 工具列表: Array(5)`
   - 该 404 不影响功能

### 建议

如果 404 持续出现，可检查：
1. 浏览器控制台：查看具体是哪个资源加载失败
2. 网络面板：确认失败的请求路径
3. 服务器日志：检查是否有相关错误

功能应正常工作。404 错误通常是浏览器尝试加载 favicon 或其他静态资源失败，不影响核心功能。

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversation = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(conversationId);\n      if (!conversation) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '对话不存在',\n        });\n      }\n\n      const requestedWorkflowId = dto.workflowId;\n      const workflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n      if (!workflowId) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n        });\n      }\n\n      let targetSources = Array.isArray(dto.sources) ? dto.sources : conversation.sources || [];\n\n      const baseMappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, workflowId);\n      if (!baseMappingConfig) {\n        const message =\n          requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === workflowId\n            ? &#96;所选工作流(${workflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n            : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n        return failure({\n          code: 'MAPPING_NOT_FOUND',\n          message,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const featureConfig = baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.find(\n        (f: FeatureObjectMapping) =&gt; f.featureType === dto.featureType\n      );\n\n      // 调试日志：检查功能对象配置\n      logger.info('查找功能对象配置', {\n        featureType: dto.featureType,\n        allFeatureObjects: baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.map((f: any) =&gt; ({\n          featureType: f.featureType,\n          workflowId: f.workflowId,\n          pageType: f.pageType,\n        })),\n        foundConfig: featureConfig ? {\n          featureType: featureConfig.featureType,\n          workflowId: featureConfig.workflowId,\n        } : null,\n      });\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst loadData = async \n // 用于去重\n      \n      for (const mapping of mappingsData) {\n        const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config.featureObjects)\n          ? mapping.config.featureObjects\n          : [];\n        if (featureObjects.length &gt; 0) {\n          for (const feature of featureObjects) {\n            const workflowId = feature.workflowId || mapping.workflowId;\n            const workflow = workflowsData.find((w) =&gt; w.id === workflowId);\n            const pageType = feature.pageType;\n            const featureType = feature.featureType;\n            \n            // 创建唯一键：workflowId + pageType + featureType\n            const uniqueKey = &#96;${workflowId}-${pageType || 'no-page'}-${featureType}&#96;;\n            \n            // 如果已经存在相同的配置，跳过（去重）\n            if (seenKeys.has(uniqueKey)) {\n              console.warn('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 发现重复配置，已跳过:', {\n                workflowId,\n                pageType,\n                featureType,\n                uniqueKey\n              });\n              continue;\n            }\n            \n            seenKeys.add(uniqueKey);\n            \n            // 尝试从工作流或AI角色中获取名称\n            let displayName = workflow?.name;\n            if (!displayName) {\n              // 如果找不到工作流，尝试从AI角色中查找\n              const role = rolesData.find((r: any) =&gt; r.id === workflowId);\n              displayName = role?.name || '未知配置';\n            }\n            \n            rows.push({\n              ...mapping,\n              workflowId\n\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'FEATURE_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: &#96;未找到功能对象映射配置: ${dto.featureType}&#96;,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // 优先使用 agentId（AI角色ID），如果没有再使用 workflowId\n      // agentId 用于直接调用 AI 角色，workflowId 用于通过工作流调用\n      const configuredAgentId = (featureConfig as any).agentId;\n      const configuredWorkflowId = featureConfig.workflowId;\n      \n      // 如果配置了 agentId，使用它；否则使用 workflowId\n      // 注意：只有当 agentId 是不同的角色时才使用它，避免使用当前工作流\n      let targetWorkflowId: string;\n      if (configuredAgentId &amp;&amp; configuredAgentId !== workflowId) {\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredAgentId;\n        logger.info('使用配置的 AI 角色', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          agentId: configuredAgentId,\n        });\n      } else if (configuredWorkflowId &amp;&amp; configuredWorkflowId !== workflowId) {\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredWorkflowId;\n        logger.info('使用配置的工作流', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          workflowId: configuredWorkflowId,\n        });\n      } else {\n        targetWorkflowId = workflowId;\n        logger.warn('功能对象未配置专属 agentId 或 workflowId，将使用当前工作流', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          fallbackWorkflowId: workflowId,\n          configuredAgentId,\n          configuredWorkflowId,\n        });\n      }\n      const targetMappingConfig = targetWorkflowId === workflowId\n        ? baseMappingConfig\n        : await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, targetWorkflowId);\n\n      const effectiveInputMappings = featureConfig.inputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.inputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.inputMappings || [];\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n;\n  }\n}",

已修复删除逻辑。修改如下：

## 修改总结

### 问题分析
之前的删除逻辑会删除整个 `workflowId` 对应的所有配置，而不是只删除特定的 `featureType` 和 `pageType` 组合。

### 修复内容

1. **修改删除函数**：
   - `handleDelete` 现在接收整个 `mapping` 对象，而不仅仅是 `workflowId`
   - 获取现有配置
   - 从 `featureObjects` 中移除匹配的 `featureType` 和 `pageType` 的配置
   - 如果还有其他 `featureObjects`，更新配置；否则删除整个配置记录

2. **改进删除确认提示**：
   - 显示要删除的具体配置信息：`"技术包装"页面的"五看"配置`

3. **优化删除状态管理**：
   - 使用唯一的 key：`workflowId-pageType-featureType` 来标识正在删除的配置
   - 确保删除按钮的禁用状态正确

### 工作流程

1. 用户点击删除按钮
2. 显示确认对话框，包含具体的配置信息
3. 获取现有配置
4. 从 `featureObjects` 中移除匹配的配置项
5. 如果还有其他配置项，更新配置；否则删除整个配置记录
6. 重新加载数据，显示更新后的列表

现在删除单个配置时，只会删除该配置项，不会影响同一 `workflowId` 下的其他配置项。

        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\nprivate toAIRoleConfig(row: AIRole): AIRoleConfig {\n\n    \n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      // Direct Agent 配置\n      // 支持两种格式：{ provider: 'direct-agent', agentConfig: {...} } 或直接是 agentConfig\n      if (configData.agentConfig &amp;&amp; typeof configData.agentConfig === 'object') {\n        agentConfig = configData.agentConfig as DirectAgentConfig;\n      } else if (configData.llm &amp;&amp; typeof configData.llm === 'object') {\n        // 旧格式：直接包含 llm, prompt, contextStrategy 等\n        agentConfig = configData as DirectAgentConfig;\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Dify 配置（向后兼容）\n      // 检查是否包含 Dify 必需的字段，或者如果 configData 不为空，假设是 Dify 配置\n      if (configData &amp;&amp; (configData.apiUrl || configData.apiKey || configData.connectionType || Object.keys(configData).length &gt; 0)) {\n        // 确保包含必需的字段，如果没有则使用默认值\n        difyConfig = {\n          apiUrl: configData.apiUrl || '/api/dify/chat-messages',\n          apiKey: configData.apiKey || '',\n          connectionType: configData.connectionType || 'chatflow',\n          inputFields: configData.inputFields || []\n        } as DifyConfig;\n      } else {\n        // 如果完全没有配置，使用默认的 Dify 配置\n        difyConfig = {\n          apiUrl: '/api/dify/chat-messages',\n          apiKey: '',\n          connectionType: 'chatflow',\n          inputFields: []\n        };\n      }\n    }\n    \n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      name: row.name || '',\n      description: row.description || '',\n      avatar: row.avatar || undefined,\n      systemPrompt: row.system_prompt || undefined,\n      provider,\n      difyConfig,\n      agentConfig,\n      enabled: row.enabled === 1,\n      source: (row.source as any) || undefined,\n      createdAt: new Date(row.created_at || Date.now()),\n      updatedAt: new Date(row.updated_at || Date.now()),\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/NODE_CONFIGURATION_GUIDE.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 205
          }
        },
        "contents": "**A**: 不可以。工作流中的Agent节点只支持Dify类型的角色。Direct Agent类型只能在独立页面或直接调用时使用。\n\n### Q3: 字段映射功能对象可以不配置agentId吗？\n\n**A**: 可以。如果不配置agentId，系统会使用当前工作流的默认配置。配置专属agentId可以实现功能对象的独立AI角色配置。\n\n### Q4: 如何查看节点的配置状态？\n\n**A**: 在AI角色管理页面（&#96;/ai-roles&#96;）的信息框中，可以查看所有节点的配置状态。绿色表示已配置，橙色表示未配置。\n\n## 六、相关文件\n\n### 核心文件\n\n- &#96;frontend/src/utils/nodeRoleMapping.ts&#96; - 节点角色映射工具\n- &#96;frontend/src/components/AIRoleConfigInfoBox.tsx&#96; - 配置信息框组件\n- &#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&#96; - 工作流Agent节点执行\n- &#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&#96; - 触发Agent逻辑\n\n### 配置文件\n\n- &#96;frontend/src/config/workflowNodes.ts&#96; - 工作流节点定义\n- &#96;frontend/src/types/aiRole.ts&#96; - AI角色类型定义\n- &#96;frontend/src/types/aiSearch.ts&#96; - 字段映射类型定义\n\n## 七、总结\n\n项目中共有**14个**需要配置AI角色的节点：\n\n- **5个**独立页面节点\n- **N个**工作流Agent节点（动态，取决于工作流设计）\n- **8个**字段映射功能对象\n\n所有配置都可以在AI角色管理页面的信息框中查看和管理。",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "**A**: 不可以。工作流中的Agent节点只支持Dify类型的角色。Direct Agent类型只能在独立页面或直接调用时使用。",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "### Q3: 字段映射功能对象可以不配置agentId吗？",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "**A**: 可以。如果不配置agentId，系统会使用当前工作流的默认配置。配置专属agentId可以实现功能对象的独立AI角色配置。",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "### Q4: 如何查看节点的配置状态？",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "**A**: 在AI角色管理页面（&#96;/ai-roles&#96;）的信息框中，可以查看所有节点的配置状态。绿色表示已配置，橙色表示未配置。",

        "contents": "# AI角色配置信息框实现总结\n\n## 一、实现内容\n\n### 1. 创建了AI角色配置信息框组件\n\n**文件**: &#96;frontend/src/components/AIRoleConfigInfoBox.tsx&#96;\n\n**功能**:\n- 显示所有需要配置AI角色的节点及其配置状态\n- 自动检查独立页面节点、工作流Agent节点、字段映射功能对象的配置状态\n- 提供快速导航到配置页面的链接\n- 显示配置统计信息（已配置/总数）\n\n**特性**:\n- ✅ 实时检查独立页面节点的AI角色配置\n- ✅ 检查字段映射功能对象的agentId配置\n- ✅ 提供创建角色、前往配置等快捷操作\n- ✅ 可折叠/展开的界面设计\n- ✅ 颜色编码的状态显示（绿色=已配置，橙色=未配置）\n\n### 2. 集成到AI角色管理页面\n\n**文件**: &#96;frontend/src/pages/AIRoleManagementPage.tsx&#96;\n\n**修改**:\n- 导入&#96;AIRoleConfigInfoBox&#96;组件\n- 在标题下方添加信息框显示区域\n- 传递roles和onRefresh回调函数\n\n### 3. 创建了配置指南文档\n\n**文件**: &#96;NODE_CONFIGURATION_GUIDE.md&#96;\n\n**内容**:\n- 详细说明所有需要配置的节点类型\n- 配置方法和优先级说明\n- 配置示例和常见问题解答\n\n## 二、识别的配置节点\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点（5个）\n\n| 节点类型 | 节点名称 | 路径 |\n|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;ai-search&#96; | AI问答 | &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; |\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; |\n| &#96;promotion-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; |\n| &#96;core-draft&#96; | 技术通稿 | &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; |\n| &#96;speech&#96; | 发布会演讲稿 | &#96;/node/speech&#96; |\n\n### 2. 工作流Agent节点\n\n- 动态数量，取决于工作流设计\n- 在工作流编辑器中配置\n- 只支持Dify类型的AI角色\n\n### 3. 字段映射功能对象（8个）\n\n| 功能类型 | 功能名称 |\n|---------|---------|\n| &#96;five-view-analysis&#96; | 技术转译（五看） |\n| &#96;three-fix-analysis&#96; | 用户场景挖掘（三定） |\n| &#96;tech-matrix&#96; | 技术矩阵 |\n| &#96;propagation-strategy&#96; | 传播策略 |\n| &#96;exhibition-video&#96; | 展具与视频 |\n| &#96;translation&#96; | 翻译 |",
